name: ODAC23
brief: Metal–organic frameworks with adsorbed CO₂ and H₂O, singly and in mixtures — modelling the two together is the point, because water competes with CO₂ for binding sites in the humid air a real sorbent has to work in. Built to train models for direct-air-capture sorbent discovery, and one of the datasets behind UMA's DAC capability.
curator: Meta FAIR-Chem (Sriram, Choi, Medford, Sholl et al.)
size: ~39M DFT single points; 176,032 relaxations across 8,412 MOFs
elements: MOF nodes span 57 metals + C, H, O, N (frameworks; CO₂/H₂O adsorbates)
paperTitle: The Open DAC 2023 Dataset and Challenges for Sorbent Discovery in Direct Air Capture
primaryPaper: Sriram et al., The Open DAC 2023 Dataset and Challenges for Sorbent Discovery in Direct Air Capture, ACS Cent. Sci. 10:923 (2024).
